note: Cross-platform HTML editor: Project groups Documents (HTML pages) and Images (uploads) as rows. A plugin widget (htmleditor) is the code editor — a code/text mode toggle that never loses either buffer, a live sandboxed <iframe srcdoc> preview, and a simple client-side tokeniser for syntax highlighting. Saving and 'save as template' both go through the core Document edit route (no plugin block needed: nothing here is a rule the server must referee, it is presentation and a pure client-side text<->HTML conversion).

pages.title: User Guide
pages.heading: Using the HTML editor
body: Every document belongs to a project, alongside the images you upload for it.

Open a document to edit it: the Code tab is a raw HTML editor with live syntax highlighting and an instant preview; the Text tab is a plain-text view of the same content that you can freely edit — press "Convert to HTML" to turn your edited text into fresh HTML paragraphs. Switching tabs without converting never loses either version.
"Save" writes your HTML back to the document. "Save as Template" does the same and also marks it as a template, so it shows up under Templates with its content untouched, ready to reuse.
Upload images for a project from its page, and give each one a caption.
